changelog: - **Undo takes back one field at a time.** Edits to a node or a connection made within about half a second of each other were one Undo step even when they were to different fields, so renaming a Pool and then setting its capacity, quickly, and pressing Undo removed both. Now each field you change is its own step: Undo takes back the capacity and leaves the new name. Typing in one field is still a single step, and a change that sets several fields at once is still undone together.
